records.failureSummary: Verified the slice: package.json has dependencies {} and devDependencies {}, engines >=22 <23, and start/test/lint/typecheck/build scripts (test = node --test); pnpm-lock.yaml is lockfileVersion 9.0 with importers .: {}; pnpm test passes 3/3 including the [AC-04] DATA_DIR plaintext-password scan and the two [AC-21] home page assertions; pnpm build exits 0. FR-7 checks pass: DATA_DIR is created and write-probed, taskboard.json is written atomically with mode 0600, users store only a scrypt structure (algorithm/N/r/p/keylen/salt/hash), no plaintext password reaches storage, the signing key is persisted 0600 and never logged, and the logger redacts password/token/authorization/secret/salt/hash. FR-8 checks pass by static review: health routers serve GET/HEAD /healthz /health /ready as 200 {"status":"ok"}; home.js renders exactly one element for each of home-title, task-list, search-input and new-task-button with Content-Type text/html and no external assets; Dockerfile uses node:22-alpine, ENV DATA_DIR=/data and PORT=3000, chowns /data to user app (uid 10001), declares VOLUME /data, ends with USER app and CMD ["node","src/server.js"] with no output redirection. Not approved for two Must gaps: README.md is still the placeholder with no install/start/test/build-image/run-image commands (PRD section 2.8, TECH-13, AC-30), and no test names contain [AC-24], [AC-25], [AC-26] or [AC-29] even though FR-9/AC-30 requires at least one AC-numbered test per Must AC with deployment ACs covered by static contract tests; [AC-01] and the optional [AC-22] are also absent. A TEST task should add the missing contract tests, and a separate documentation/backend task should replace README.md.
